issue.title: Gateway checkpoint fix, notification hygiene, and retention sweep (items 11-13)
issue.description: A busy SQLite WAL checkpoint reports busy instead of erroring, read paths checkpoint passively, and the gateway serves a cached fleet snapshot at once while one rebuild runs in the background. remote-attention keeps one row per request, wait_checks raises one notice per failed root blocker with a one-key expire action, and task-bead triage keeps one notification per bead. Settled triage gate bundles are reaped. Notification payloads over 8 KB move to sidecar files, and broken file references are pruned. file-hooks successes are silent, workspace-rescue dedups, prune nudges have a size floor, agent_state_refresh logs each unchanged verdict once, and no-op claim-ledger rows stop. Tool-run logs, tui.log, proc log locks, registry temp files, and index backups follow stated horizons.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md requests this work

issue.title: Treat SQLite's busy -1 checkpoint result as busy and checkpoint passively on read paths
issue.description: wal_busy: in sase-core, a busy wal_checkpoint that returns -1 counts reports checkpoint_busy instead of failing u64 conversion. The gateway's post-build hook uses PASSIVE and runs after waiters are woken. Maintenance keeps TRUNCATE. Move the pin.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase wal_busy as one work unit

issue.title: Serve cached fleet snapshots stale-while-revalidate in the gateway
issue.description: gateway_swr: an expired cached snapshot is served at once, marked stale, while one background rebuild runs. Index-permit waits are bounded. A cold cache keeps today's bounded wait. Record the relationship on sase-1s5 and move the pin.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase gateway_swr as one work unit

issue.title: Key remote-attention rows by stable request identity
issue.description: attention_key: remote-attention rows key on (origin, request_id). A new revision updates and resurfaces the one row. An identical re-emission writes nothing. A local dismissal still sticks for its revision. Legacy per-revision rows migrate once.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase attention_key as one work unit

issue.title: Add opt-in sidecar storage for oversize notification payloads in sase-core
issue.description: blob_store: sase-core stores action_data values and notes over a caller-supplied byte limit as content-addressed sidecar files, with a read binding. Compaction garbage-collects unreferenced sidecars and prunes broken files references. Default behavior is unchanged. Move the pin.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase blob_store as one work unit

issue.title: Resolve sidecar payloads in every reader, then externalize payloads over 8 KB
issue.description: blob_adopt: the TUI, Telegram, and mobile readers that need full action_data or note text resolve sidecar references. Then the Python store wrapper externalizes payloads over 8 KB by default, and live oversize rows migrate once.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase blob_adopt as one work unit

issue.title: Raise one wait_checks notice per failed root blocker and freeze its +1s
issue.description: wait_blocker: terminally blocked waiters group under one notice per root blocker that names every direct and transitive waiter. The notice changes only when its waiter set changes and never +1s otherwise. Legacy per-waiter rows settle once.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase wait_blocker as one work unit

issue.title: Offer a one-key action that expires a failed blocker's waiters
issue.description: waiter_expire: under blocked_waiters = offer, the root-blocker notice gets a one-key TUI action. It expires every waiter the notice names through the existing user cancel path for a waiting agent, records the blocker as the reason, and settles the notice. Nothing expires waiters automatically.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase waiter_expire as one work unit

issue.title: Keep one task-triage notification per bead across presentation changes
issue.description: triage_volume: measure which fingerprint inputs churn triage gates. Stop canceling and recreating a pending gate for presentation drift the gate does not render. Recreated gates reuse one notification row per bead. Remove or keep the quiet-task-beads rule per the decision.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase triage_volume as one work unit

issue.title: Settle orphaned triage gates and reap settled gate bundles
issue.description: gate_reconcile: a pending automation-owned gate whose notification was dismissed, or whose bead is resolved, is cancelled. A dismissal is not undone by the next pass. Settled task-triage and snooze bundles older than a horizon are reaped. Other gate kinds are only counted.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase gate_reconcile as one work unit

issue.title: Silence success toasts, dedup workspace-rescue, floor prune nudges, and skip no-op claim writes
issue.description: notify_quieting: file-hooks successes become one silent row per hook, and workspace-rescue gets a stable dedup key. Artifact-run prune nudges fire only above a size floor or under disk pressure. hold_workspace_claim writes no ledger row when nothing changed.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase notify_quieting as one work unit

issue.title: Log each unchanged agent_state_refresh verdict once
issue.description: state_refresh_memo: agent_state_refresh persists each run's unresolved verdict with an evidence fingerprint. A pass that sees the same fingerprint skips the warning and the dismissed-bundle lookup. A changed fingerprint re-evaluates and logs once. Stays clear of sase-1s5.3's lookup changes.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase state_refresh_memo as one work unit

issue.title: Apply the tool-run log horizon on a schedule, age-rotate tui.log, and verify digest and run pruning
issue.description: log_horizons: an hourly housekeeping chop applies the existing tool-run retention owner, not only under disk pressure, and removes emptied run dirs. tui.log rotates by age as well as size. Verify error-digest pruning and that artifact_run_prune is unblocked on both hosts.

issue.title: Fix the proc log-lock and registry temp-file leaks and reap their backlog
issue.description: clutter_reapers: deleting proc logs also removes their lock files. The name-registry writer sweeps its own stale temp files under its lock. Owner steps reap both backlogs from the log_horizons chop. Index backups follow the index_backups decision.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/hygiene_gateway_notifications_retention.md defines phase clutter_reapers as one work unit

pattern = re.compile(r"^\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) [^]]+\] \[checks\] \[agent_state_refresh\] (.*)$")

MECHANISM: notification_gates had no safe in-place presentation update (bundles are write-once and hash-verified), so a re-presentation recreates the gate but keeps one row. create_gate(notification_id=...) lets a successor adopt an existing row: reconcile_notification_rows refreshes only content fields (notes, files, action_data, chip) and keeps read, dismissed, timestamp and +1s; a born-snoozed gate re-applies its wake time; a failed creation restores the predecessor content. cancel_gate(settle_notification=False) retires the superseded bundle without dismissing the shared row. bead_task_triage creates the successor first (adopting the pending gate row), then retires the predecessor; if creation fails it keeps tracking the old gate; the request_id_conflict branch from b6f6c63e3e is kept and retires a conflicting gate that holds the carried row without settling it; the untracked sweep leaves a row that now presents another gate. A new unread row appears only on a kind change or when the bead re-enters ready. presentation_fingerprint is now kind-scoped: inputs a kind does not render are pinned empty (FlagTriage: +1 evidence, close history; non-snooze kinds: snooze), so every existing TaskTriage/BeadSnooze stored fingerprint is byte-identical (checked against the pre-change code) and install causes no mass re-presentation.

CONTRACT for waiter_expire (sase-1tz.4.1.7): root notices are sender=wait_checks, dedup_key 'wait_checks:terminal-blocker:{blocker artifact_dir}' (ROOT_BLOCKER_DEDUP_PREFIX in src/sase/scripts/_chop_wait_checks_root_notice.py), action=None today. action_data (all strings): blocker_artifact_dir, blocker_outcome, blocker_dependency, blocker_name ('' when unknown), waiter_count, waiters = JSON list of {artifact_dir, name, project[, via=upstream waiter artifact_dir]} (direct waiters have no via), and wait_checks_auto_dismissed='true' only while the job settled the row (AUTO_DISMISSED_ACTION_DATA_KEY; reconcile_notification_rows reversible marker). The job settles the row itself once every waiter is gone, so the expire action may simply expire waiters and dismiss; the next tick reconciles. Adding an action/action_data keys must go through _build_root_blocker_notification so _same_content keeps unchanged passes write-free.

From sase-1tz.4.1.6: root-blocker notice action_data contract (waiters JSON list with artifact_dir/name/project/via, blocker_* keys, wait_checks_auto_dismissed marker) is recorded as a CONTRACT note on sase-1tz.4.1.6 and in the module docstring of src/sase/scripts/_chop_wait_checks_root_notice.py.
